create_seggpt_image_segmentation: create a SegGptForImageSegmentation model to perform one-shot image segmentation using prompt images and masks
run_seggpt_encoder: run the SegGptModel encoder to extract hidden states and attention weights from image and prompt inputs
build_seggpt_decoder: build a SegGptDecoder to reconstruct predicted masks from intermediate hidden states of the encoder
test_seggpt_attention: test the SegGptAttention multi-head attention block with relative position embeddings for spatial reasoning
review_seggpt_loss: review the SegGptLoss function that computes L1 loss between predicted and ground truth masks on masked patches
